description: This file is a shell script for orchestrating end-to-end tests of the OpenClaw project on multiple virtualization platforms (macOS, Windows, Linux). It sets up environments, runs baseline and update tests, manages VM and server processes, and generates a JSON summary of test results.

methods.name: say
methods.description: Prints a message with a prefix '==>' followed by the arguments.

methods.name: warn
methods.description: Prints a warning message with 'warn:' prefix to stderr.

methods.name: die
methods.description: Prints an error message with 'error:' prefix to stderr and exits the script.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Kills the server process if running and removes temporary directories.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage instructions for the script.

methods.name: resolve_linux_vm_name
methods.description: Resolves and outputs the best matching Linux VM name based on requested version, via Python script.

methods.name: resolve_latest_version
methods.description: Fetches the latest version of 'openclaw' package from npm registry.

methods.name: resolve_host_ip
methods.description: Detects and outputs the host IP address for the Parallels environment.

methods.name: allocate_host_port
methods.description: Allocates and outputs an available TCP port on the host.

methods.name: ensure_current_build
methods.description: Runs 'pnpm build' to prepare current project build.

methods.name: pack_main_tgz
methods.description: Packages the current git HEAD into a tgz using npm pack, stores path.

methods.name: write_windows_update_script
methods.description: Generates a PowerShell script for Windows VM update process.

methods.name: start_server
methods.description: Starts an HTTP server in the main tgz directory to serve update packages.

methods.name: wait_job
methods.description: Waits for a background process and verifies its success, optionally dumps logs.

methods.name: extract_log_progress
methods.description: Parses logs to extract progress information for monitoring.

methods.name: dump_log_tail
methods.description: Outputs the last 40 lines of a log file for debugging.

methods.name: monitor_jobs_progress
methods.description: Periodically checks the status of multiple background jobs and reports progress.

methods.name: extract_last_version
methods.description: Extracts the last OpenClaw version string from a log file.

methods.name: guest_powershell
methods.description: Encodes and executes a PowerShell script inside the Windows VM.

methods.name: host_timeout_exec
methods.description: Runs a command with a specified timeout, handling timeout errors.

methods.name: guest_powershell_poll
methods.description: Performs periodic PowerShell command execution inside Windows VM with timeout.

methods.name: run_windows_script_via_log
methods.description: Runs a Windows update script through the guest VM and monitors logs.

methods.name: run_macos_update
methods.description: Performs update process inside macOS VM using pre-designed shell script.

methods.name: run_windows_update
methods.description: Performs update process inside Windows VM using generated PowerShell script.

methods.name: run_linux_update
methods.description: Performs update process inside Linux VM with inline shell commands.

methods.name: write_summary_json
methods.description: Generates a JSON report summarizing the test outcomes.
